action.description: plan evaluates the safety checks without changing anything. execute takes a snapshot first (the volume is kept) and deletes the volume in a later execute once the snapshot has completed.

volumeId.description: ID of the EBS volume to delete, in the region of the function.

pvName.description: Name of the PersistentVolume the volume was created for (its kubernetes.io/created-for/pv/name tag). Confirm in the cluster that this PersistentVolume no longer exists first.

snapshot.description: Take a snapshot and wait for it to complete before deleting. Only set to false when the data is known to be disposable.
